generate_fwd_headers: run gen_fwd.py to generate C++ forward declaration header files from TOML configuration
create_smart_pointer_aliases: generate shared_ptr, unique_ptr, and weak_ptr type aliases for C++ classes and structs
render_jinja2_template: render the Jinja2 header_template with namespace, headers, structs, and classes to produce C++ code
parse_toml_config: parse gen_fwd_input.toml to extract module definitions including subdirectory, namespace, and type lists
format_generated_headers: run clang-format on generated fwd.h files to ensure consistent C++ code formatting
